title: keel standing policy
description: A Board-signed standing policy in .keel/policies/<id>.yaml. A contract policy (for example quick-patch) stands in for the per-change contract approval of a change started with keel new --policy <id>, whose verbatim request the Board signs; a land policy stands in for the per-change land approval and is named by config land.policy. Every predicate is checked by code on the actual diff; a change that fails one needs the per-change approval instead. Policies are revocable, apply only with a valid signature, and every receipt lists the policies it used.

id.description: Policy id; equals the file name stem.

track.description: The track the policy applies to (patch for the adopted quick-patch policy).

expires.description: Date or date-time after which the policy stops applying, or null. Revoke earlier by signing a removal.

predicates.description: Deterministic predicates over recorded signals and the actual diff.

max_elements.description: Maximum elements touched; paths no element maps count as none.

touches_protected_globs.description: Whether the change may touch protected globs.

touches_invariants.description: Whether the change may touch paths an INV applies to.

touches_obligations.description: Whether the change may touch paths an ADR obligation applies to.

touches_arch_rules.description: Whether the change may touch paths an architecture rule reaches.

touches_contracts.description: Whether the change may touch declared interfaces between elements.

touches_public_api.description: Whether the change may touch a public-api element or path.

adds_acceptance.description: Always false: new ACC items always need a per-change contract approval.

requirements.description: What a change on this policy must additionally carry.

signed_request.description: The Board signs the verbatim request (keel new --policy).

red_green_proof.description: At least one cited scenario, or a test fixed first by a different-family test task, fails at the base commit and passes at the change commit.

lens_set.description: Lens set from org/seats/reviewer.yaml (by name; its lenses are listed only there) that always runs on a different declared family.
